newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SHARES MIXED, WAITING FOR HALF-YEAR RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: SHARES MIXED, WAITING FOR HALF-YEAR RESULTS.

text.p: * Vilniaus Bank drops to 220.10 litas from 230.00 litas.
* Hermis Bank holds steady at 190.00 litas.
* Rokishkis Cheese slides to 40.50 litas from 42.00 litas.
* Snaige plunges to 12.30 litas from 13.50 litas.
* Brokers say shares will disappoint them this week as investors wait for half-year results.
